author: Bloodoh
body: Guys, im really really sorry about that, i were so stupid when i did it, but, i have never hacked before on avicus, it was my first ban due to hack, and when i admitted that i used Posighdun told me to appeal in 1 month, and i did and i got denied, i dont know why, but guys, im really really sorry about that, i apologised and i will never do it again. Please guys give me 1 opportunity, every 1 deserves one, please :(.
